change.whyItIsOnePatch: Both files are the same decision seen twice: where each toolbar is mounted and how the sections order it. The mount half was already sitting uncommitted in the desktop checkout with no patch covering it - a scan of all 51 dirty sessions files found exactly these two uncovered - so this patch also closes that reproducibility gap. Running prepare-desktop on a clean checkout before this patch would have produced a title bar without the left/right placement.

fixedVisibleDifferences: Back and Forward now sit after the sidebar toggle in the left section, where they were before it.
The IDE button now sits before the panel and side-panel toggles in the right section, where it was the right-most control.
The patch stack now reproduces the title bar region placement on a clean checkout instead of relying on uncommitted files in the desktop checkout.
remainingVisibleDifferences: The reference title bar shows no Show Panel / Toggle Side Panel controls at all; ours keeps them because the sessions window shares the layout actions with the IDE. Removing them is a separate decision about what the Agents window may hide.
Both sections still reserve the macOS traffic-light inset, so the left group starts at x=84 rather than hard against the window edge.
